analysis.title: Top of Mind: Is the AI investment cycle durable?
key_insights: Goldman's Top of Mind issue dated 10 Nov 2026 asks whether the AI investment cycle is durable, citing recent AI-related market stresses and new regulatory uncertainty.
The issue draws on interviews with Social Capital's Chamath Palihapitiya and GS analysts Eric Sheridan and Miriam Wheeler, plus other GS credit and equity research analysts.

It covers four questions: the source of the current stresses, who holds the risk in the AI ecosystem, where the outlook for AI return on investment stands, and how investors can navigate the current moment.
The text provided is only the email summary and cover page. It contains no figures, ratings, price targets or conclusions from the full report.
risk_factors: Recent AI-related market stresses are raising questions about the durability of the AI investment cycle.
New regulatory uncertainty is affecting the AI theme.
The report examines who holds the risk in the AI ecosystem, but the summary does not give its answer.
